verdict.rationale: An llms.txt is served on the help center (help.drata.com/llms.txt, which indexes content such as the rollout toolkit guide), so an agent can be pointed at Drata's help docs. However, probes found no llms.txt, no markdown doc variants, and no fetchable OpenAPI spec at any tested path on developers.drata.com. The developer/API docs are therefore not exposed in agent-friendly form. Missing for 10: llms.txt and markdown versions of the developer API docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path, and independent confirmation that agents can use the help-center llms.txt effectively.
